About the Practice

Mayo Clinic in Arizona is a multi-campus academic medical center offering safe, innovative, and integrated world-class care on its main campuses in Scottsdale and Phoenix, as well as satellite primary care clinics. It provides inpatient and outpatient medical services, specializing in tertiary care and destination medicine for complex cases. Comprehensive primary care services are also available, covering preventive care, diagnosis and treatment of illnesses, outpatient procedures, and management of chronic conditions for patients of all ages.

Electronic Health Record System

Epic

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Mayo Clinic refers to their patient portal as "Patient Online Services" or the "Mayo Clinic Patient Portal". This portal allows patients in Arizona, and other Mayo Clinic locations, to manage aspects of their healthcare online, such as viewing medical records, scheduling appointments, and communicating with their care team. Mayo Clinic transitioned to a single, integrated electronic health record (EHR) and revenue cycle management system from Epic. This implementation, known as the "Plummer Project," was completed in phases across all Mayo Clinic locations, including the Arizona campuses in Phoenix and Scottsdale, where the Epic system went live on October 6, 2018. Before this transition, Mayo Clinic had been using multiple EHR systems, including those from General Electric and Cerner Corp. The move to Epic was a significant investment aimed at improving efficiency and providing a unified patient experience across all Mayo Clinic sites. Therefore, the patient portal used by Mayo Clinic Arizona is connected to the Epic EHR system.
